mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Coffee Gold Project, ~130 km south of Dawson City, Yukon (700 km2 / 70,256 ha). Acquired from Newmont (closed Oct 2025) for up to US$150M; Newmont retained ~19% equity + 3% NSR; Agnico Eagle owns ~8%. 2026 PEA: 13-year open-pit heap-leach operation producing avg 249,000 oz/yr gold in first 5 full years, 217,000 oz/yr LOM; AISC US$1,274/oz. Resources: 80 Mt @ 1.15 g/t M&I = 2.96 Moz Au; 21.2 Mt @ 1.17 g/t inferred = 800 koz Au. Feasibility study underway (40,000 m 2026 drilling; Supremo Extension infill converting high-grade inferred ounces). Permitting: positive YESAA decision (2022); key road permit secured Sept 2026 (29 km new road completing 214-km route); quartz mining and Type A water licences pending; construction decision targeted early 2027. No production or reserves yet.

notes: Formerly Fuerte Metals Corp.; renamed Talamore Mining Corp. June 2026; graduated from TSX-V to TSX effective Aug 11, 2026 (TSX:TALA; OTCQB:TALMF). Developer; no FY2025 production, revenue, or reserves. Flagship: Coffee Gold Project as above (PEA 2026). No other material assets. All amounts in USD unless noted.
